description: Welcome to Chorus Music v1.2.2! This release introduces the all-new Adaptive Lock Screen Player (Beta) with universal biometric hardware support, dynamic album art theme backgrounds, background playback wakeups, and lifecycle optimizations.

changelog.title: New Features & Improvements
items: Lock Screen Player (Beta): Show Chorus playback directly over your phone's lock screen with native Keyguard integration
Universal Biometric Replica: Automatically adapts to your phone's biometric setup (in-display optical/ultrasonic scanner, side-mounted sensor, or face unlock) with zero fake overlays
Nothing OS & OEM Replica: Displays the exact circular biometric scanner ring matching your phone and triggers real physical hardware sensor illumination
Dynamic Album Theme: Replaces the wallpaper with a rich ambient gradient sampled from the current track's album art across both Card and Immersive modes
Dual Visual Styles: Choose between elevated 'Card' mode with live seekbar & controls or full-bleed 'Immersive' mode with frosted blur vignettes
Notification Shade Access: Pulldown gestures from the top half of the screen seamlessly open the Android SystemUI notification drawer and quick settings
Reliable Background Wake: Seamlessly opens over the lock screen on screen turn-on even when Chorus is running only in the background
Appearance Settings: Added a 'BETA' badge and an instant one-tap 'Display over other apps' overlay permission helper

changelog.title: Bug Fixes & Refinements
items: Card Player Overlap: Fixed layout issue where controls were overlying or touching the player card
Immersive Haziness: Eliminated background haziness with top and bottom frosted blur vignettes
Strict Recents Cleanup: Lockscreen player automatically dismisses immediately when the app is removed from Recent Apps
Playback Dismiss: Automatically closes the lock screen player when songs are removed from the player or playback stops
Screen Sleep / Lock: Fixed screen timeout and lock timing when turning screen off
Thumbnail Corner Radius: Fixed missing preview asset in the corner radius selector dialog
